reviews.text: I purchased this app for $4.99. Now they’ve locked all the timers I’ve created until I pay them another $7.99?!

reviews.text: I have no idea what to do with this new update. You can’t even create new timers. There is literally no add button at the bottom anymore or the top. I have Seconds pro lifetime subscription I should not be going through this.

reviews.text:
Is there a way for me to get my $8 back?  I should have tried the free trial prior to purchase. This app does
not perform as
advertised, is not easy to use or program, and has no capability to change the tones or types of start/end alarms. If possible, I’d like a refund..I can not use this timer.

reviews.text:
Since the recent update, I am unable to create new timers even though I paid years ago to upgrade and have lifetime seconds pro access! 
Prior to this I loved the app and would recommend it to anyone, now it is frustrating! 
Have deleted it, reinstalled it, restored purchases and still nothing. Very disappointing!
Not keen on the black screen either.

reviews.title: It WAS good

Imagine my surprise when I’m getting ready to start my workout only to find out that someone thought it was a good idea to charge in order for me to access the timers I already created. Greed is something else.

reviews.title: Worked well in the past…
reviews.text: This app worked very well earlier this year. However, I guess when the phones operating system was updated, this app still has bugs. For example, I’ve told it not to write data to my health/fitness app, but it still does it everyday. I use this app to teach my fitness classes, and some days, like today when I’ve taught 6 classes, it’s showing me exercising for 300 minutes. I don’t use it for my own fitness so I’m not sure why it’s doing this. It’s so frustrating.

I purchased this app 3 months ago and have not used it… I can’t figure it out.  Waste of my money… :( very disappointed that I don’t have support. And that I am no successful. :(

reviews.title: New sync is terrible

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: You can only use your program once, then you have to create it from scratch or pay $8. A developer deserves compensation but $8 is far too dear for what amounts to the essential functionality of an ostensibly free app.

reviews.title: Not intuitive and no instructions
reviews.text: I have had this app for YEARS. I can figure out a custom timer but when I know I’m doing a Tabata style workout (which they give you an option for!) it doesn’t make any sense how to set it up or why it should require this much figuring out if I have specifically toggled “Tabata style” on… after years of frustration figuring this out I think I’m looking for something else. I don’t use it often but when I pick it up I don’t want to have to mess around for this long trying to figure things out

reviews.title: Challenging to troubleshoot. Often does not sync. Currently not syncing at all for me
reviews.text: I use this app to teach Pilates classes. The app is really unreliable when you need to update timers. Extremely frustrating. Now it is the worst it’s ever been. I resynced my whole watch to fix this and now I have no timers and the app will not sync to my phone at all anymore. I cannot emphasize enough that I have tried everything to sync it. It won’t sync. So now, I’ve paid for an app that will no longer work. I hope I can fix it because I don’t want to have to pay for another app nor do I want to re input all my routines, but I think I’m at that point now.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work on MacBook. Purchases don’t transfer
reviews.text:
I’m very unhappy with this app. I wanted a timer that would sync and work with my Apple Watch. The custom timers i created show up on my watch but there’s a lock image next to it and will not play from my watch. Only on my phone. 

Also i built custom timers, if i want to repeat the exercises for a 2nd or 3rd lap, there’s no option to loop the workout. You have to add eta exercise and set every time you do it. Huge inconvenience and time consuming. 

I was deciding between this and another timer ap to purchase and really regret purchasing this one but since I already did, I continued to use it , generally on my iPad its been great, but I got rid of my iPad and upgraded to a MacBook. The app purchase did not transfer over nor can I transfer or download timers from my previous account. I had to repurchase this app multiple times and they refuse to give me a refund.

reviews.title: Complicações não funcionam
reviews.text: Com atualização do IOS, a complicação do AppleWatch foi desabilitada, e desenvolvedor não atualiza o app para corrigir o bug. Era meu principal uso. Favor corrigir.

reviews.title: Do not buy this app!! It’s no longer usable on Apple Watch.
reviews.text: I used to LOVE this app but they updated it in the last month and now the app is completely useless on my Apple Watch which means the $8 I spent was pointless. It no longer shows the time remaining in an interval, it just says the interval time the whole time. It doesn’t transition at the right time. It makes a loud beep noise and no longer uses vibration, even when it’s set to use only vibrate. The UI is also different and doesn’t lock the interval on the screen. It’s completely useless to me now, I can’t use it to teach my fitness classes. Really frustrating experience. And yes, I’ve done all the troubleshooting (turn off, turn on, uninstall, restore purchase, etc etc). I’ve spent a ridiculous amount of time trying to fix it and I’m done. Unfortunately I won’t get my money back either.
